description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted the third Training and Education Committee meeting. The Chair, Brenda Burgard, co-facilitated with Catherine Warnock. They presented on a training model for psilocybin facilitators, treatment framework, proposed practicum structure and suggestions for equitable and safe implementation of the Medical Psilocybin program in NM.
fulltitle: Medical Psilocybin Training and Education Committee - April 10, 2026
